Problem Statement:
Accept a string and find if it is of date format 'dd/mm/yy'. 
Input Description:
It contains a date 
Output Description:
Print the date is valid or not 
Sample Input:
19/14/1999 
Sample Output:
Not valid 
Explanation:
There are only 12 months.But in input we have the month as 14.Hence it is not valid
